Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve is a destination for experienced hikers who have the needed equipment and supplies. The rolling fell and forest landscape make for wonderful hiking terrain, but the area's large bogs are best to circle. Pöyrisjärvi has always been an important fishing, hunting and reindeer husbandry area for locals. The Sámi villages of Kalkujärvi and Pöyrisjärvi are located within the wilderness area and are still inhabited for part of the year. There are no marked trails within Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve but there are many old unmarked trails. There are great possibilities for canoeing excursions, fishing and mountain biking.

Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve is a destination for experienced hikers who have the needed equipment and supplies. The rolling fell and forest landscape make for wonderful hiking terrain, but the area's large bogs are best to circle. Pöyrisjärvi has always been an important fishing, hunting and reindeer husbandry area for locals. The Sámi villages of Kalkujärvi and Pöyrisjärvi are located within the wilderness area and are still inhabited for part of the year. There are no marked trails within Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve but there are many old unmarked trails. There are great possibilities for canoeing excursions, fishing and mountain biking.
The wilderness reserve safeguards Sámi culture and traditional livelihoods, as well as protects the pristine nature of the wilderness
Impressive sand dunes and ridges
Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve is nestled in the centre of several other protected areas, and Pöyrisvuoma Mire Reserve is within Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Area
The areas two largest rivers the Pöyrisjoki and the Käkkälöjoki are especially good for canoeing and fishing
Several open wilderness huts and the Bievrrašjávri/Pöyrisjärvi open wilderness and shared rental hut
Natural features of Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve
The area is known for its fells, sand dunes, extensive marshlands, and clear lakes. The wilderness provides a habitat for many plants and animals.

Everyman’s Right apply in the wilderness area
Temporary camping in the area is allowed
Making campfire is allowed in the terrain
Remember to bring a trash bag

stops.name: Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve
stops.detail: Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve ist ein Ziel für erfahrene Wanderer, die die benötigte Ausrüstung und Vorräte haben. Die rollende fiel und Waldlandschaft sorgen für wunderbare Wandergebiete, aber die großen Moore der Gegend sind am besten zu kreisen. Pöyrisjärvi war schon immer ein wichtiges Fischerei-, Jagd- und Rentierzuchtgebiet für Einheimische. Die Samendörfer Kalkujärvi und Pöyrisjärvi liegen in der Wildnis und sind noch einen Teil des Jahres bewohnt. Es gibt keine markierten Trails innerhalb von Pöyrisjärvi Wilderness Reserve, aber es gibt viele alte unmarkierte Trails. Es gibt großartige Möglichkeiten für Kanuausflüge, Angeln und Mountainbiken.
